sentence: This project studies how a gene tied to ciliary dysfunction relates to the formation of comedones in rare and common comedonal diseases.
This project builds a human model of the intestine that grows several tissue types together, including smooth muscle, endothelial cells and enteric neurons.
This project studies genotype and phenotype information from a regional sample to help build polygenic scores for biologically relevant quantitative traits.
This project uses genetic analysis of families and large pedigrees to find causes of stillbirth that were not recognized before.
This project studies the virulence of atypical Toxoplasma strains in a laboratory animal model and looks for virulence factors using functional genomic approaches.
This project studies reciprocal genomic disorders using experimental models of human brain development, including neuronal cells and cerebral organoids.
This project provides imaging and electron microscopy services for probing the structure and function of proteins, cells, tissues and model organisms.
This project builds a method that measures many proteins at once to find and check biomarkers for Alzheimer’s disease.
This project tests whether gene therapy can treat chronic kidney disease caused by Alport syndrome, using a dog model of the syndrome.
This project uses machine learning on patient data to predict outcomes and build tailored treatment options for periodontitis.
This project uses total-body positron emission tomography to study the immune response in patients with persistent symptoms following COVID-19 infection.
This project studies the host inflammatory response to Mycobacterium tuberculosis in human lung granulomas and maps where drugs spread inside them.
This project studies brain and behavioral states that make people at high risk for suicide susceptible to stressors, using in-home experiments.
This project builds computational methods to search for, sort and find RNA structural motifs and to predict what non-coding RNA genes do.
This project uses surveys and smartphone assessments to study how online experiences and offline risk, resilience and mental health affect each other in adolescents.
This project studies how self-organization of a key pathogen and the evolution of antimicrobial resistance affect each other in spatially structured communities.
This project describes how a comprehensive cancer center plans and evaluates its leadership and research programs.
This project builds web-based tools and a data hub of transcriptomics data to help researchers study polycystic kidney disease.
This project tests whether vaginal microbiota transplant can shift the vaginal microbiome toward Lactobacillus dominance in women with recurrent bacterial vaginosis.
This project develops antiviral leads that are safe, potent and orally available to treat monkeypox virus infections.
